chapter.verse: Judah kumpi Hezekiah’ lai-atte in a tei Solomon’ paunak dangte:
Pasian in thu a ip manin minthang a, kumpite in thu a gen khiat manin minthang hi.
Vantung sang lua a, lei sung a thuk luat mah bangin, kumpipa’ ngaihsutna thuk lua-in kithei zo lo hi.
Ngun a ek teng paaikhia lehang, siksekpa in na hoihpi piangsak thei hi.
Kumpipa kiang pan migilote nilkhia lehang, thuman-a ama ukna kip thei bek hi.
Kumpipa mai-ah na om ciangin milian kineih kei in la, miliante’ tutna ding munah tu kha kei in.
Uliante a awn dingin hia lai-ah va tusuk in hong kicih sangin, hih lai-ah hong tuto in, hong kicih ding hoihzaw hi.
Thu khatpeuh na theih ciangin, thukhen zum tun’ pah kei in. Na vengpa in nang’ khialhna hong laktel kik leh, nang’ bang lawh nawn ding na hi hiam?
Na thuneihpih na vengpa bek mah tawh thu kisel in la, mi khat’ thusim midang tungah genthaang kei in,
Tua hi kei leh amah hehin nang hong maizumsak ding a, na minsiatna bei ngei lo ding hi.
A kilawm hun-a kammal khat paukhiatna in, ngunpeek tunga kham tang khat a kisuang tawh kibang hi.
Hilhna a sangthei mipa’ adingin a pil thuhilhpa in, kizepna kham bilbah tawh kibang hi.
Amah a sawlte tungah a citak kamtaipa in, an lak hun-a tuikhal vot tawh kibang a, a tote’ lungsim thak suaksak hi.
Bangmah a piak lohpi a kisialhpihpa in, guah a zusak tuan lo meiipi leh huihpi nung tawh kibang lel hi.
Lung duai-a zolzolna tawh gam ukte kizo thei a, kamnem-a pauna tawh aana neite kizo thei hi.
Khuaizu na nek ciangin a hoih khop zah bek ne in; tua hi kei leh kham lua-in na lua ding hi.
Na vengte inn-ah hawh mun lua kei in; hong cimtakin hong mudah kha ding hi.
A lawmte’ lang khatah teci man lo a pang mi in, molhtum, namsau, ahih kei leh thaltang hiam tawh kibang hi.
Haksat hunin a zuautat mi muan-a neih khakna in, ha na, ahih kei leh khebai tawh kibang hi.
A dah a lungkham mipa kianga lasakna in, khuadam lai taka puan suahkhiat tawh kibang a, meima ci-al nuh tawh kibang hi.
Na galte a gil a kial leh an pia in la, a dang a taak leh tui pia in.
Tua hi leh amau’ maizum nadingin a bawl na hi a, Topa in nang tungah thaman hong pia ding hi.
Leilu lam huih in guah a zuksak bangin gensiatna in hehna piangsak hi.
Phun bek a thei zi tawh inn sungah teen’ khop sangin, innkhumzang kiu khat-a tang teen’ hoihzaw tham hi.
A dangtak mipa in tuivot lim a sak bangin, gamlapi-a om lawmte kiang pan-a thupha zak nuam kisa hi.
Mihoih khat in mihoih lote’ gamtatna a zuih khak ciangin, hawktui nin, ahih kei leh tui uih tawh kibang hi.
Khuaizu tamlua nek ding a hoih loh bangin, phat ding deih luatna in hoih lo hi.
Ama lungsim a ki-uk zolopa in, dalna kulhpi a nei lo khuapi tawh kibang hi.
